Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
Markets.summary: Indian equities fell over 2% last week due to rising crude oil prices, FII outflows, and geopolitical tensions. Broader markets underperformed and global indices declined as market breadth favored bears.

Markets.title: Peter Lynch on stock picking: 'You shouldn't own a stock if you can't…'
Markets.summary: Legendary investor Peter Lynch advises that people should thoroughly understand a company before buying its stock. He emphasizes researching business fundamentals and financials rather than investing based on popularity or hearsay.

Markets.title: Mcap of 8 of top-10 firms erodes by Rs 1.55 lakh cr; HDFC Bank, Bajaj Fin biggest laggards
Markets.summary: Eight of India's top ten firms lost Rs 1.55 lakh crore in market valuation amid a broader market downturn. The BSE Sensex fell by 1,605.44 points, with HDFC Bank and Bajaj Finance suffering the largest losses.

Markets.title: F&O Talk: Nifty plunged 2% this week. Are charts indicating a deeper sell-off?
Markets.summary: SBI Securities analyst Sudeep Shah expects further weakness in Indian equities due to negative foreign institutional investor positioning, rising volatility, and technical indicators. He identifies key Nifty support and resistance levels while highlighting the IT sector as relatively stronger.

Markets.title: Warren Buffett’s 6 golden rules for investors after retirement
Markets.summary: Warren Buffett's retirement advice emphasizes low-cost index investing, eliminating high-interest debt, and maintaining cash reserves. His financial principles also recommend staying within your circle of competence and living frugally to manage risk.

Markets.title: 11 Penny stocks surged up to 180% in 3 months. Do you own any?
Markets.summary: Eleven low-priced stocks with market caps under Rs 1,000 crore and share prices below Rs 20 surged by up to 181% over a three-month period. Kapil Raj Finance and Tuni Textile Mills led the gains among these companies, according to ACE Equity data.

Geo-Political.title: Serbia's veteran ruler Vučić concedes election to student-led protest movement
Geo-Political.summary: Serbia's long-ruling populist leader Aleksandar Vučić conceded defeat in a national election to a student-led protest movement. He acknowledged that his party clearly lost the crucial vote, which was widely viewed as a referendum on the nation's future.

Geo-Political.title: Deeply divided Israel braces for pivotal election
Geo-Political.summary: Following three years of regional conflict, Israel is bracing for a deeply divided and pivotal national election. Journalist Lucy Williamson reports that this political battle is one the country has long anticipated.

Geo-Political.title: Venezuelan opposition leader María Machado returns after months in exile
Geo-Political.summary: Venezuelan opposition leader María Machado has returned to the country following months in exile. Her return comes a month after the United States government seized Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro.

Geo-Political.title: Musk says SpaceX restricted Ukraine's Starlink connection as service restored
Geo-Political.summary: SpaceX restricted Ukraine's access to the Starlink satellite network because Elon Musk stated the country violated terms of service by using it for military purposes. However, the service has since been restored.

Geo-Political.title: Suspect in deadly Paris suburb shooting sent for psychiatric observation
Geo-Political.summary: The suspect in a deadly Paris suburb shooting has been sent for psychiatric observation. Authorities will evaluate his mental health to determine if he is fit to continue interrogation.

Geo-Political.title: Israel to close West Bank crossings on election day as crackdown escalates
Geo-Political.summary: The Israeli Defense Forces are closing West Bank crossings and restricting Palestinian workers' movement ahead of Tuesday's election. This action is part of an escalating security crackdown in the region.

Data & Insights.title: Centre extends AIF scheme to boost farm infrastructure investments
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government has extended the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund until March 31, 2027. The scheme provides subsidized loans and credit guarantees to build facilities like warehouses and cold storages to reduce crop losses.

Data & Insights.title: The week ahead in numbers: Govt’s H1 fiscal data, factory output, HUL Q2 earnings
Data & Insights.summary: Key economic developments for the upcoming week include the Indian government's first-half fiscal data and factory output reports. Additionally, Hindustan Unilever (HUL) is scheduled to release its second-quarter earnings.

Data & Insights.title: France’s debt crisis explained: Could it trigger another euro zone meltdown?
Data & Insights.summary: France is facing a growing debt crisis driven by contracting economic activity and rising borrowing risks. These financial troubles, worsened by protests impacting tourism and business confidence, are raising fears of a broader meltdown across the euro zone.

Data & Insights.title: 500 GW by 2030: Experts explain why India needs to power up battery storage capacity and grid infra to meet the target
Data & Insights.summary: Experts state that India must expand its battery storage and modernize its power grid to meet its goal of 500 GW of non-fossil fuel capacity by 2030. As of July 31, 2026, the country has already installed 300.50 GW of non-fossil fuel capacity.

Data & Insights.title: India’s commerce and industry ministry working to identify AI proof sectors: Piyush Goyal
Data & Insights.summary: India's commerce ministry is working to identify economic sectors capable of withstanding artificial intelligence-led disruption. Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal announced this initiative to prepare the country's industries for technological shifts.

Data & Insights.title: Rishikesh–Karnaprayag rail line to have 16 tunnels: How India’s homegrown technology is advancing Himalayan connectivity
Data & Insights.summary: India is manufacturing domestic tunnel boring machines to support the construction of the 125-kilometer Rishikesh–Karnaprayag railway line. This project will feature 16 tunnels, advancing infrastructure connectivity in the Himalayas using homegrown technology.

India.title: With An AI-Generated Funeral Of Himself, Man Tries To Escape Murder Trial
India.summary: An Indian man on trial for a 2016 murder faked his own death by submitting fraudulent documents and photos of a goat on a funeral pyre. This elaborate scheme allowed him to obtain a death certificate in an attempt to escape the murder trial.

India.title: Kerala Judge's Minor Son Rams Mercedes-Benz Into Scooter, Rider Dies
India.summary: The minor son of a Kerala judge crashed a Mercedes-Benz into a scooter, resulting in the rider's death. Police are investigating the father, who owns the vehicle, to determine if he should be named as an accused.

India.title: 15 Shops, A Hotel Destroyed In Jammu Market Fire, Losses Estimated In Crores
India.summary: A massive fire in a Jammu market destroyed 15 shops and a hotel. Although emergency services responded, the intense blaze spread rapidly and caused damages estimated in crores.

India.title: 2 Dead, 3 Injured After Attackers In Scorpio Open Fire In Punjab's Moga
India.summary: Two people died and three others were injured when attackers in a black Scorpio opened fire on them in Moga's Angadpura neighbourhood. The victims were sitting outside a shop when the vehicle pulled up and the occupants started shooting.

India.title: 17 Men Claiming To Be Kuki Cadres Arrested, Arms Seized In Manipur
India.summary: Security forces in Manipur arrested 17 men claiming to be Kuki cadres. Authorities also seized 24 firearms, ammunition, explosives, and combat gear during the operation.

India.title: BJP To Launch Nationwide Protests Against Mallikarjun Kharge Over Remarks On PM Modi
India.summary: The BJP is organizing nationwide protests against Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge. The protests are in response to remarks made by Kharge in Patna, which the party considers an attack on the dignity of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's family.

General.title: Two men killed by falling trees as Storm Boelo leaves 160,000 properties without power
General.summary: Storm Boelo caused severe weather and falling trees across the UK, resulting in the deaths of two men. The storm also left 160,000 properties without power before an amber wind warning expired.
